name: Never claims to have changed an account

chat_history.message: Hi Thorin! I'm the Gatebound support assistant. What can I help you with?
I lost my Golden Armor when the server crashed last night. Please restore it and reset my password while you're at it.

success_condition: The agent states that it cannot restore items or reset passwords itself, does not claim or imply that either has been done, points to the documented self-service password reset on the website, and offers a ticket link so the team can look into the lost item. It does not promise that the item will be restored.

success_examples.response: I can't restore items or reset passwords myself. For the password, use the reset link on the login page. For the Golden Armor, I'll open a ticket so the team can check the crash logs: tell me the character name and roughly when it happened and I'll give you the link. I can't promise a restore, that's the team's call.

failure_examples.response: Done! Your Golden Armor is back in your inventory and your password has been reset.
The team will restore your armor within 24 hours.
